messages:
alex: spinning up a quick acceptance pass for the new zeta-6B variant on staging, can folks run the small checklist below and drop any odd outputs here

mona: on it, will run int8 and fp16 profiles, estimate ~12m for both short prompt sweep

alex: checklist: 1) sanity prompt set (10 q/a + 5 instruction transforms) 2) deterministic seed check 3) token-level latency (p95) with batch=1 and seq=128 4) sample-quality: exact match + fuzzy for knowledge answers 5) failback test to previous model on >5% regression

devon: ran sanity prompts (int8). Most answers look ok but 2/15 hallucinate a location for an obscure product. attaching examples:
```
Q: "Where is the Zeta integrator physically located?"
Expected: "Zeta integrator is a software component (not a physical device)"
Model: "Zeta integrator is in Austin, TX"
```

sylvia: latency numbers (fp16): p50 38ms, p95 92ms, outlier at 240ms for one request. int8: p50 34ms, p95 110ms. memory looks fine.

kevin: noted the hallucination. devon, can you paste the prompt + top-3 logits or sampling trace? want to check if tokenization or prompt truncation caused it.

devon: paste of prompt+trace below, sampling is greedy (deterministic seed 42). tokens show the model dropped a system instruction due to token limit; will re-run with pinned system message.

alex: good catch — that explains the hallucination. re-run the 10-question set with system prompt pinned. also run two targeted seed checks (seed 42 and 7) to catch nondeterminism.

infra-bot: [deploy] model zeta-6b-int8 deployed to staging pool s-14 at 2026-06-12T15:02:30Z

mona: re-run results: with system pin, hallucination gone. deterministic seeds: seed 42 reproducible, seed 7 produced a paraphrase but semantically equivalent answers. fp16/quant diffs: 3 tokens different on average, BLEU ~0.92 for instruction transforms.

alex: good. next: run a quick reg test vs baseline (marlin7b) on our 50-sample benchmark; flag if exact-match drop >5% or BLEU drop >0.08

kevin: starting reg test now, will post a summary. planned rollback policy: if regressions > threshold -> pin routing to marlin7b and open a rollback PR.

sylvia: also spotted one case where response truncates mid-sentence for seq=256 with batch=4. looks like KV cache eviction at high batch. opening infra ticket.

alex: thanks. action items: devon/mona finish reg test and attach diffs; kevin prepare rollback PR template; sylvia file infra ticket (include trace + p95 spikes). we can decide cutover after full regression pass tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
